e: Nani mo Umaku Ikanai Tokitte Dare Datte Aru to Omoundakedo Sonna Toki Ore wa Dou Suru ka tte? Kimatteru sa Tada Hitasura ni Sakebinagara Hashirundayoo AAAAA!
Kyoukashita Fuku o Kiteitara Tsuukon no Ichigeki de Hakaisare Trauma o Kakaeta Private Kôde Joshi ni Konshin no Ichigeki o Kurau.
Ninenkan Hikikomotteta Nakama no Shazai ni Doukoushitara Angai Usagi Ringo Dashitekureta kara Mou Yurusutte Koto da to Omounda.
Koko made Nikai mo Zenra ni Natte Shimatta Ore Dakarakoso Wakatta Koto ga Hitotsu Arunda... Zenra wa Nido Kamareru tte ne.
Chouri suru Shîn wa Nain Dakedo Jitsu wa Honkakuteki na Ryouri Datte Tsukurerun Dakara ne to Apiru Onna wa Honô o Matowase Ken o Nuku.
Shitsukoi Komusume da na... Nani mo Kawaran Komusume ga Omae wa Konkai mo Nani mo Dekinu... Sore demo Atashi wa Rirî Furamuberu daaa!
Ano Pan-ya ni wa Ichido mo Itta Koto ga Nakatta node Kore o Ki ni Meron Pan de mo Hoobatte Inu no Sanpo ni de mo Iku ka Wafu.
